title: Scientific Calculator
description: A keyboard-friendly scientific calculator with a real recursive-descent expression parser (no eval), DEG/RAD/GRAD modes, memory, inverse trig via a 2nd key, and a running calculation tape. Single file, no dependencies.

title: Snake
description: A classic grid-based Snake game built with Python's Tkinter — pause/resume, increasing speed, and a game-over overlay. No external dependencies.
